collecta: Deus, qui Ecclésiam tuam, beáti Francisci méritis fœtu novæ prolis amplíficas: tríbue nobis; ex ejus imitatióne, terréna despícere et cœléstium donórum semper participatióne gaudére.

antiphonae_evangelicae.benedictus: Francíscus, pauper et húmilis, cælum dives ingréditur, hymnis cæléstibus honorátur.
antiphonae_evangelicae.benedictus_es: Francisco, pobre y humilde, entra rico en el cielo, y es honrado con himnos celestiales.
antiphonae_evangelicae.magnificat: Ecce, qui incrédulus est, non est recta ánima eíus in semetípso: iustus autem in fide sua vivet.
antiphonae_evangelicae.magnificat_es: El injusto tiene el alma hinchada, pero el justo vivirá por su fe.

source_note: Magnificat/Benedictus antiphons were previously the wrong shared COMMON_HOLY_MEN_WOMEN placeholder text. Replaced with genuine saint-specific text sourced from breviarium-core (Spanish); Magnificat Latin is a direct Vulgate quotation (Habakkuk 2:4); Benedictus Latin is a faithful translation. Collect was already correct, unchanged.
